note: Minto Park Board campground in the city park along the Forest River, beside the ball diamonds; playground, pickleball and basketball courts, picnic shelters. --Claude
summary: Park board page confirms $35/day (weekly $225, monthly $750), full hookups (amps unstated), showers, WiFi, online registration form + dropbox payment; now manual. Phone should be 701-248-3231. Pin likely ~380 m off (to the RV strip by ND-17).
flags: PIN MOVE (>250 m, imagery): stored 48.2828,-97.3745 falls on the open field/riverbank in the south of the park bend. Imagery shows a ~60 m pull-alongside pad strip with about six evenly spaced posts (pedestals) inside a loop drive on the east side of the park, just west of the highway, centred ~48.2855,-97.3718, with a small outbuilding ~48.2849,-97.3716; the ND HHS roster lists MINTO PARK with 6 lots, matching. Google's park pin (1001 2nd St) is 48.28586,-97.37252 at the ball-field building. Suggest location = 48.2855,-97.3718 (about 380 m NE of the stored point). Not confirmed by any official map.
PHONE: stored 701-248-3858 is on no park page; the park board site gives 701-248-3231 on its home and contact pages (Google shows the same). Suggest phone = 701-248-3231.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The Forest River loops around the park, but the pad strip sits ~60 m west of the highway and the river channel beyond it; trees between.
FIT: pull-alongside strip on a loop drive; no length posted; a 23-ft rig fits.
SITES: no count published; HHS roster 6 lots (not written).
